content.title:
Divisible by 3, 9 or 11?
*Check in 5 seconds.*
content.legend: 3 or 9: add the digits. 11: the alternate-digit difference is 0 or a multiple of 11

caption:
Divisible by 3, 9 or 11? Check in 5 seconds 📌

3 and 9: add the digits. 7425 → 18, so it divides by both.
11: alternate sum. (5 + 4) − (2 + 7) = 0, so 7425 divides by 11 too.

Save this for your next number system set.
